summary: Short kerb with detached homes 4 to 6 m away on the same side.

best_section.where: Adsett St kerb south of the rail-side corner

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses at 4 m and 6 m on the kerb side, apartments at 14 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street, a few cars parked south end; room is tight.
drivers.traffic: Rail line and a through road at the corner; quiet beyond it.
drivers.convention: A few cars park near the south end, but signs say no parking weekdays.

flags: Dwelling within 10 m rules it out
sun_shade: Trees and houses shade the east side; open to the afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Street lighting is mapped but not visible overhead
